meta.title: Miu Tarot
meta.description: Draw Tarot cards with Miu: gentle prompts for reflection. For guidance and entertainment only.

home.title: One card, one gentle prompt for today.
home.lead: Draw one card each morning, or lay out three for a bigger question. Miu sits beside you and tells you what each card wants to say.
home.decksTitle: Each deck has its own voice.
home.decksLead: The meanings stay the same; only the telling changes. Pick the deck that fits today's mood.
home.featuresTitle: One card for today. Three for the whole story.
home.dailyBody: Draw a card, read a message. Enough to step out the door with a clear intention.
home.threeBody: See your question as a flow: what has passed, what is here, and what is coming.
home.meetLead: A little chatty but very kind. Miu guides you step by step, reacts to every card and always has a remark of her own.
home.meet1: Reminds you of each step: shuffle, pick, flip.
home.meet2: Cheerful or thoughtful, depending on the card you flip.
home.meet3: A playful remark for every card in the card guide.
home.touchMiu: Tap Miu to hear what she says
lines: Meow! I'm Miu. You ask, the cards answer, and I… comment.
Did you know? Every card has two sides: upright and reversed. Just like a cat's mood.
Stop scratching my chin… okay, a little more is fine.
My favourite is The Sun, warm like a sunny spot by the window.
Ready? Tap “Chat with Miu” and let's draw!

draw.title: Draw cards
draw.question: Question
draw.questionHint: Up to 200 characters. Ask about something you would like to understand better.
draw.questionPlaceholder: What would you like to ask? (optional)
draw.sampleAria: Suggested questions, tap to fill the question box

love: Where is my current relationship heading?
What can I do to open my heart to new love?
What is getting in the way of me and my partner understanding each other?
career: Should I change jobs in the near future?
What will help me grow in my career?
What should I pay attention to in my current project?
study: What should I focus on to study more effectively?
How can I feel more confident before my upcoming exam?
Should I keep pursuing this field of study?
finance: What should I watch in my spending lately?
How can I save more consistently?
Should I start a new financial plan?
mind: What has been weighing on my heart lately?
What can I do to rebalance my emotions?
How should I take care of myself right now?

say.intro: Hi, I'm Miu! Choose a deck, a spread and a topic, then tap “Shuffle”.

say.introDrew: You already drew today's card. Drawing again is fine, but the first card usually speaks truest, meow.
say.intro1: Hi, I'm Miu! Pick a topic and tap “Shuffle”, and I'll draw one card for your day.
say.topic: Topic: {topic}. Think about what you want to ask.
say.restart: I'll shuffle again from the start.
say.shuffling: Shhh-shuffle… Take a deep breath and think of your question.
say.spread1: The cards are all spread out. Pick the one that seems to call your name.
say.spreadN: The cards are spread out. Pick 3 in order: {positions}.
say.picked: Here's the card for “{label}”. {n} to go.
say.landed1: Done! Tap the card to flip it.
say.landedN: All three are in! Flip them one by one, or all at once.
up: Oh, {name} upright! A good sign, meow~
rev: Hmm, {name} reversed… Don't worry, I'll explain.
{name} is upside down. There's something to notice.
say.flipped1: The card is revealed! Tap “See the meaning” when you're ready for the message.
say.flippedN: All three are revealed! Tap “See the meaning” when you're ready for the message.
say.listening: Miu is listening to the stars...
say.done: Here is the message of the cards for you. This reading has been saved to your history.
say.again: Let's draw again! Change the topic if you like, then tap “Shuffle”.

hints.safety: Message shown when a question signals distress; no reading is given.
hints.intents: Each intent has an id, a keywords list and lead sentences (use {question}).
hints.lead: Opening sentences with or without a question ({question}, {topic}).
hints.overview: Overview sentences by the lean of the whole spread ({topic}).
hints.positions: Sentences per position and tone (positive, neutral, caution).
hints.cards: Per-card sentences keyed by card id (for example fool). Use {} if none.
hints.transitions: Bridging sentences between two tones, e.g. positive>caution ({from}, {to}).
hints.pairs: Sentences for card pairs, keyed "idA+idB" in alphabetical order. Use {} if none.
hints.single_flow: Sentences when only one card is drawn.
hints.closing: Reflection questions: common, by topic, and the closing note.
hints.card_tone: [upright, reversed] tone of each card: positive, neutral or caution. Vietnamese only.

legal.title: Content notice
legal.entertainment: Miu Tarot is for guidance and entertainment. The cards are prompts for reflection, not certain predictions about the future.
legal.noAdvice: Content is not medical, psychological, legal or financial advice and does not replace a professional. For important decisions, consult a qualified person.
legal.ai: The "In-depth analysis" is assembled from pre-written content based on the cards you draw and your question; it is not generated by AI at viewing time. It is for reference only.
legal.age: The service is for people aged 18 and over.
legal.privacy: The Privacy Policy and Terms of Use are available via the links below.

footer.line2: Tarot is for reference and entertainment and does not replace professional advice.
